_comment: Hand-authored manifest for reference/environment-variables. scripts/generate.mjs --check greps packages/{agent,middleware,next,sdk}/src for VHYXVOID_* and fails on any name missing here or listed here but no longer read. Add a row here when a package starts reading a new variable.

vars.name: VHYXVOID_SECRET
vars.description: API key secret, shown once when the key is created.

vars.name: VHYXVOID_PORT
vars.default: `3000`. `@vhyxvoid/next` looks for `-p` / `--port` in the command that started Next first, then this variable, then `PORT`, then `3000`.
vars.description: Local port the tunnel forwards to.

vars.name: VHYXVOID_LABEL
vars.description: Tunnel label: the part of the tunnel URL after `--`. In the SDK it picks which tunnel `createClient` targets.
vars.cliDescription: Tunnel label: the part of the tunnel URL after `--`. Run one agent per label to expose several servers.

vars.name: VHYXVOID_HUB_URL
vars.description: WebSocket URL of the hub the agent connects to.

vars.name: VHYXVOID_QUEUE_PATH
vars.description: Where the CLI agent keeps its on-disk queue. The in-process integrations do not use a queue.

vars.name: VHYXVOID_WRITE_ENV
vars.description: A file name. When set, the agent writes the public URL into that file after it connects (see `VHYXVOID_ENV_KEY`).
vars.cliDescription: After connecting, write the public URL into a file. Give a file name, or none for `.env.local`.

vars.name: VHYXVOID_ENV_KEY
vars.description: Name of the variable that `VHYXVOID_WRITE_ENV` writes.

vars.name: VHYXVOID_DEBUG_LOGGING
vars.description: Only the exact value `true` turns on detailed diagnostics. The in-process integrations embed the agent, so the variable affects them too.
vars.cliDescription: Print detailed diagnostics: one or more lines per message and per request. Off by default.

vars.name: VHYXVOID_ACCOUNT_SLUG
vars.description: Your account slug, the part of the tunnel URL before `--`. The SDK reads it; the CLI's `init` offers it as the default answer and writes it into `.env.vhyxvoid`, but the agent itself never uses it.

vars.name: VHYXVOID_HUB_DOMAIN
vars.description: Domain that `createClient` builds the tunnel URL from.
